cards.name: Model Gateway
cards.hint: OpenAI-compatible proxy (LiteLLM). Routes inference to llama.cpp.
cards.notes: User-facing Open link = the LiteLLM admin UI at /ui/ (swagger at /), which must be served from an origin ROOT (root-absolute asset paths) - hence the `llm` subdomain, not a /llm/ subpath. `sso_port`/`sso_path` are the sidecar-off fallback (https://<host>:8449/ui/); see services_catalog.service_open_url().
